findings.evidence: Lines 97-123 already provide exactly this structure for the long-long case and are used at 168, 177, 185; the terminal branches get none. Exponent check against mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Cartan.lean:128-134: for `j` long adjacent to the last node, `B (n+1) j i` hits `i.val = (n+1)-1` and is `-2` (exponent 2); for `j = last`, `i` long adjacent, it hits `i.val + 1 = j.val` and is `-1` (exponent 1).
findings.fix: Add named private lemmas mirroring lines 97-123 for the terminal node, with the exponents that actually hold: `⁅typeBShortRootMatrix (Fin.last n), typeBLongRootMatrix j.castSucc j.succ⁆ = 0` for `j.val + 1 ≠ n`; `(ad K _ (typeBShortRootMatrix (Fin.last n)) ^ 2) ⁅e_short, e_long⁆ = 0` for `j.val + 1 = n`; and the two reverse-orientation lemmas `⁅e_long, e_short⁆ = 0` (non-adjacent) and `⁅e_long, ⁅e_long, e_short⁆⁆ = 0` (adjacent). Then each branch is a `rw [hpow] ; exact <lemma>` as at lines 167-169.
findings.issue: The mixed short/long branches (137-145 and 147-155) close the substantive cases — including the terminal double edge, where the exponent is 2 and `pow_two, Module.End.mul_apply` expand `ad^2` — with `split_ifs <;> simp_all [...] <;> omega`, mixing the Cartan-entry case split with the matrix-unit computation across all branches. Nothing shows which branch proves the double-edge relation, and `simp_all` rewrites the `hjn`/`hj` hypotheses `omega` then consumes. This also pushes the proof to 53 body lines (134-186).

findings.evidence: `CartanMatrix.B` is `Matrix.of fun i j => if i = j then 2 else if i.val+1 = j.val then (if j.val = n-1 then -2 else -1) else if j.val+1 = i.val then -1 else 0` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Cartan.lean:128-134); Mathlib exposes only `B_diag` (line 163) and `B_off_diag_nonpos` (line 170), and no in-repo entry lemma is reusable here (`cartanMatrix_B_apply_eq_neg_two` in TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/DynkinType.lean:319 is `private`), so each site re-derives the entry from the raw body.
findings.fix: Prove one private lemma, e.g. `(-CartanMatrix.B (n+1) (j : Fin n).castSucc (i : Fin n).castSucc).toNat = if i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val then 1 else 0` (for `i ≠ j`), with a terminal `split_ifs <;> omega`, and `rw` it at all three sites; add the analogous entry lemma for the terminal node used at 142/152.
findings.issue: The same Cartan-entry computation is repeated three times (162-166, 171-175, 179-183) as `simp [CartanMatrix.B, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.ext_iff]` followed by a non-terminal `omega`; the `omega` depends on whatever goal shape the default simp set leaves after unfolding Mathlib's `B` if-chain, and the same unfolding is redone inline at lines 142 and 152.

summary: The long-long cases are cleanly factored into named helpers, but the two mixed short/long branches — which carry the terminal double-edge content — are still discharged by an opaque `split_ifs <;> simp_all [...] <;> omega`, and the `CartanMatrix.B` exponent computation is still duplicated three times as a non-terminal `simp` followed by `omega`.
